svg.title: Industrial machine connectivity - reconstruction of the AWS reference
svg.desc: EOT Twin Talk sends time-series data directly to SiteWise and asset metadata through S3, Lambda and DynamoDB. SiteWise updates flow through IoT Core and Firehose to an industrial data lake. Reconstruction, not an AWS-authored diagram.
